transcript: Speaker A: Aryan beta, tell everyone about your school. [Aryan, tell everyone about your school.] Speaker B: Hello, my name is Aryan and I see many wonderful things in school. What would you like to know? Speaker C: Yeh meri galti hai. Maine usse angreji seekhne mein madad hi nahi ki. Us raat maine English Seekho download kiya, ek rupaye ka trial. Maine kaha, "Pari, ab roz 15 minute hum dono milke seekhenge." Hindi mein samjhane wale chhote videos aur AI coach se chat practice 24 ghante. Pari galti karti, AI sudhaar deta, kabhi hansta nahi. Main bhi saath baithti thi, main bhi toh seekh rahi thi. 100 baar galti, 100 baar pyaar se sudhaar. [This is my fault. I didn't help her learn English. That night I downloaded English Seekho, a one-rupee trial. I said, "Pari, now we both will learn together for 15 minutes daily." Short videos explaining in Hindi and 24-hour chat practice with an AI coach. Pari made mistakes, the AI corrected them, and never laughed. I also sat with her, I was learning too. 100 mistakes, corrected 100 times with love.] Speaker D: Are Pari, tumhe kya pasand hai? Hindi mein hi bata do. [Pari, what do you like? Just tell us in Hindi.] Speaker E: Good evening everyone. I love painting. Would you like to see my drawings? Speaker C: She practices every night, and honestly, so do I. Agar aapke ghar mein bhi sirf kisi aur ke bachche ki tareef hoti hai, ₹1 ka trial lo, roz 15 minute. [She practices every night, and honestly, so do I. If only someone else's child gets praised in your house too, take the ₹1 trial, 15 minutes daily.] Speaker F: Install button par click karo aur English Seekho app download karo. [Click the install button and download the English Seekho app.]
